lines.t: I've held on to this world, like it was all I knew
Trying to keep my life instead of giving it to you
But you are calling softly, past the noise, beyond the fear
Teaching me to let go, and draw my spirit near
Not with empty words, not with half a heart
I wanna come to you, just as I am
Yeah, who's sure? I come with open hands
Leaving all the world behind again
Take the weight, take the fear
Take the things that keep me here
Yeah, who's sure? Make my heart brand new
Let there be no hate in what I do
I wanna be free
I wanna belong completely to you
If there's anger in my heart, help me lay it down
If there's someone I can't forgive, turn me back around
I don't wanna carry what you never asked me to
I wanna walk in mercy, the way you walked in truth
Take away the bitterness, take away the blame
Teach me how to love the way you love my name
Yeah, who's you?
I come with open hands, leaving all the world behind again
Take the weight, take the fear
Take the things that keep me here
Yeah, who's you? Make my heart brand new
Let there be no hate in what I do
I wanna be free
I wanna belong completely to you
I will not hold on
To what is passing by
You are my life
You are my reason
Why no malice, no revenge, no bitterness inside
Only your mercy, only your love
Yeah, who's sure?
I come with open hands
Free from all the things I can't command
Take my heart, take my days
Lead me in your holy way
Yeah, who's sure when you call my name
Let me come to you without shame
With nothing held back
I'd give my whole life to you
